antipattern.code:
Fine-grained Tensor Parallelism (TP) allows you to split model weights
across devices with TP degrees granularity. This feature provides
more flexible parallelism strategies compared to standard TP.


With TP degrees, you can configure different parallel sizes for
different layers of the model, enabling more efficient resource
utilization.
